# TokenOut

> TokenOut is a private, native macOS menu bar app for monitoring AI coding-tool limits, usage, tokens, cost, reset times, and history.

Canonical website: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app
Official source: https://github.com/SyntaxFear/TokenOut
Latest download: https://github.com/SyntaxFear/TokenOut/releases/latest/download/TokenOut.dmg
Release history: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/releases
Privacy policy: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/privacy
Signed update feed: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/appcast.xml
Extended product reference: https://tokenout.scrubmac.app/llms-full.txt

## Supported tools

- Claude Code: live session and weekly limits, transcript tokens, model breakdowns, and cost estimates.
- OpenAI Codex: primary and secondary rate-limit windows, rollout history, plan details, and workspace breakdowns.
- Google Antigravity: local sessions, turns, daily activity, and estimated tokens where quota data is unavailable.

## Product facts

- Current version: 1.0.0.
- Requires macOS 14 or later.
- Universal build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
- Native SwiftUI menu bar application with no Dock icon.
- Local-first history; no TokenOut account, analytics, advertising SDK, telemetry backend, or cloud sync.
- Signed Sparkle automatic updates distributed from the official update feed.
- Open-source code and release notes are available in the official GitHub repository.
